title: Speed, stated plainly
body: Last day: the image encoder (one frame ahead) and the memory attention became half-precision Core ML programs called from Rust: a frame took 0.57 to 0.60 of the time of the day before
Then the necks, on the encoder's thread: 0.89 to 0.92 of that frame; then the memory encoder: 0.83 to 0.87 of that
Tracking accuracy held at each step: HOTA 0.5695 over 1,500 frames, against 0.5700 before
About 1.0 s per frame on dense video (VISEM 36), detection and tracking together, on an M5 Pro: not real time yet
The existing SAM 3.1 Core ML port is Core ML too, but only the tracker: no text prompt, no detection, no new tracks
